import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def rot(m): return [list(r) for r in zip(*m[::-1])]
for k in (1,2):
    inp=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; out=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    bg=max(set(sum(inp,[])),key=lambda c:(sum(inp,[])).count(c))
    ps=[(i,j) for i in range(len(inp)) for j in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[i][j]!=bg and inp[i][j]!=0]
    pi=min(i for i,_ in ps); pj=min(j for _,j in ps)
    pr=max(i for i,_ in ps); pc=max(j for _,j in ps)
    ph,pw=pr-pi+1,pc-pj+1
    P=[row[pj:pc+1] for row in inp[pi:pr+1]]
    zr=[(i,j) for i in range(len(inp)) for j in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[i][j]==0]
    bi,bj=min(i for i,_ in zr),min(j for _,j in zr)
    bh,bw=max(i for i,_ in zr)-bi+1,max(j for _,j in zr)-bj+1
    ob=[out[i][bj:bj+bw] for i in range(bi,bi+bh)]
    # find dihedral match: try all 8 transforms of P

        r=[m,m[::-1],[r[::-1] for r in m]]
        rs=[]
        for base in [m,[r[::-1] for r in m]]:
            cur=base
            for _ in range(3):
                rs.append(cur); cur=rot(cur)
        return [c for r in rs for c in [r, [r_[::-1] for r_ in r]]]
    hits=[i for i,c in enumerate(dihedral(P)) if c==ob]

import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
def solve(inp):
    bg=max(set(sum(inp,[])),key=lambda c:sum(inp,[]).count(c))
    ps=[(i,j) for i in range(len(inp)) for j in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[i][j]!=bg and inp[i][j]!=0]
    pi=min(i for i,_ in ps); pj=min(j for _,j in ps)
    pr=max(i for i,_ in ps); pc=max(j for _,j in ps)
    ph,pw=pr-pi+1,pc-pj+1
    P=[[inp[i][j] for j in range(pj,pc+1)] for i in range(pi,pr+1)]
    zr=[(i,j) for i in range(len(inp)) for j in range(len(inp[0])) if inp[i][j]==0]
    bi,bj=min(i for i,_ in zr),min(j for _,j in zr)
    bh,bw=max(i for i,_ in zr)-bi+1,max(j for _,j in zr)-bj+1
    ob=[row[::-1] for row in P]
    out=[r[:] for r in inp]
    for i in range(bi,bi+bh):
        for j in range(bj,bj+bw):
            out[i][j]=ob[i-bi][j-bj]
    return out
for k in (1,2):
    ok=solve(G[f'Demo pair {k} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    print(k,ok)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
